QuestionStmt.S: The work done by a gas as it is taken in a cyclic process (shown in graph) is

Solution.S:
In a cyclic process, the net work done by the gas is equal to the area enclosed by the cycle on the P-V diagram.

From the graph, the cycle is a triangle. The vertices are at:

- Point A: (V, P)
- Point B: (V, 4P)
- Point C: (3V, P)

Area of triangle ABC:

Base = (3V - V) = 2V

Height = (4P - P) = 3P

Area = $\frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times 2V \times 3P = 3PV$

The cycle is clockwise, so work done by the gas is negative. Therefore:

$$W = -3pv$$

Thus the correct option is D: $-3pv$.
